parse.title: Widgets
parse.wikitext:
{{Classification}}'''Widgets''' are items in ''[[Battlefield Heroes]]'' that are similar to [[Specializations]] and are used to assist players. Widgets are obtained through [[Play4Free Funds]] in bundles and may then be used in-game. There are six widget categories: Support, Attack, Fun, Boost, Jump and Run, and Vehicle.
